source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Πρόχορος εκ Γεωργίας»

attestations.note: The day's line gives him only «εκ Γεωργίας», from Georgia, which is the nation of the monks among whom he lived rather than a place he is said to have come from; his page puts his whole life at Jerusalem. He is not the deacon Prochorus of the Seventy, nor Prochorus of Vranski, whom this corpus already keeps.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
